plain: Final terms or demands that end the talks if refused

webster.text: In diplomacy, the final propositions, conditions or terms offered as the basis of a treaty; the most favorable terms that a negotiator can offer, and the rejection of which usually puts an end to negotiation.

example.quote: Here again we are brought to our ultimatum: — is the legislature so constructed as to deserve our confidence?
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIV, Jan. 17, 1788
